reason: Review affected frontend packages, required validation commands, and browser evidence coverage.
Check TerminalHome markup, native anchors, static fallback completeness, and presentation/style ownership.
Check command input, focus, keyboard, failure recovery, and progressive-enhancement behavior.
Check strict config/runtime/browser decoders, immutable records, and fail-closed DOM assumptions.

Check public-only output, safe external URL attributes, deterministic generation, and source/private leakage.
Check strict `terminal.friends` parsing, examples, safe URL policy, duplicate rejection, and no-secret configuration.
Check for duplicated link/list/focus rules and missed existing helpers after the cross-layer change.
Review the complete config-to-renderer-to-runtime data flow and neutral/direct shell parity.
Check every confirmed product decision, acceptance criterion, and out-of-scope boundary.
Check implementation against the approved command, config, security, recovery, and compatibility contracts.
Check that the implementation preserves existing Terminal visuals, responsive density, focus contrast, and reduced-motion expectations.
